about: A database created by the framework binary built from main at 7e9bbc7c (2.7.317 in main.go), the commit before reserved-word names were quoted in generated DDL: `benmore serve` was started once with the first schema recorded in the ledger below, rows were added to projects and memberships with sqlite3, and it was started again with app/schema.prisma. app/migrations/ holds the two files that binary wrote. objects is its sqlite_master in creation order; ledger is _benmore_migrations. TestExistingDatabaseSeesNoSchemaChange restores it and loads it with the current code.
sqlite_version: 3.35.5 (reader); written by the framework's bundled SQLite

objects.name: trg_projects_updated_at_updated
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_projects_updated_at_updated
AFTER UPDATE ON projects
FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at AND (NEW.updated_at IS NULL OR julianday(NEW.updated_at) < julianday(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) BEGIN
  UPDATE projects SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
END

ledger.source:
// An app as it exists today: ordinary names, and names that are SQL
// keywords SQLite accepts bare (key, desc, action, offset, first, last, end,
// plan, query, view, cast, raise).

model Project {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId    Int      @map("user_id")
  name      String
  key       String   @unique
  desc      String?
  action    String   @default("none")
  offset    Int      @default(0)
  total     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @default(now()) @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  tasks     Task[]

  @@index([userId, createdAt(sort: Desc)])
  @@map("projects")
}

model Task {
  id        Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId    Int       @map("user_id")
  projectId Int       @map("project_id")
  project   Project   @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])
  title     String
  first     String?
  last      String?
  end       DateTime?
  plan      String?
  query     String?
  view      Int       @default(0)
  cast      String?
  raise     Float?
  quantity  Int       @default(1)
  price     Float     @default(0)
  amount    Float     @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime  @default(now()) @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  deletedAt DateTime? @map("deleted_at")

  @@index([projectId])
  @@unique([projectId, title])
  @@fulltext([title, plan])
  @@map("tasks")
}

model Membership {
  projectId Int    @map("project_id")
  userId    Int    @map("user_id")
  level     String @default("member")

  @@id([projectId, userId])
  @@map("memberships")
}
